name: Daily County-Level Admission Counts
description: Daily County-level Medicaid inpatient hospitalization counts (n_hosp__<cohort>) and beneficiary counts (n_bene__<cohort>) by cohort (e.g., n_hosp__total, n_hosp__ffs, n_bene__total, n_bene__ffs). Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year, excluding restricted-benefit enrollees such as emergency-only, family-planning-only, or Medicare cost-sharing-only). Daily files carry the corresponding monthly/yearly enrollment values for each day.
